name: Shuumatsu no Ashita-tei de Kanpai o.
original_name: 終末の明日亭で乾杯を。
source:
From jaded, worn-out survivors to bright-eyed hopefuls, the Time's End Tavern serves many kinds.

Frequent customers include a grizzled veteran Hunter, a rookie aspiring to legend, a profit-savvy merchant, and a scholar of the mysterious Deep Forest.

Their everyday lives are fraught with peril - slaying zombies, losing comrades, and dragging themselves through the mud to survive.

They gather to share stories and sip cocktails, reminding themselves they're still human.

But the peace doesn't last, as more and more raiders and zombie hordes roam the wasteland.

As Tina's seed takes root and begins to grow, so do the dangers that loom at the end of the world.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4353810/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
从疲惫不堪的幸存者到目光明亮的希望者，时光尽头酒馆为各种各样的人提供服务。

常客包括一位头发花白的老猎人、一位立志成为传奇的新人、一位精明的商人和一位研究神秘森林深处的学者。

他们的日常生活充满了危险——杀死僵尸、失去战友、在泥沼中挣扎求生。

他们聚在一起分享故事，品尝鸡尾酒，提醒自己他们仍然是人类。

但和平并没有持续多久，越来越多的掠夺者和僵尸群在荒原上游荡。

随着蒂娜的种子生根发芽，世界末日的危险也随之而来。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4353810/]Steam[/url]]
